status: Provisional theoretical scheduled Q102 passenger places; not observed ridership or actual available capacity.
service_day_definition: GTFS service date selected by scheduled trip service_id. Includes after-midnight departures from the preceding stop; not a midnight-to-midnight crossing count.
crossing: Roosevelt Island Bridge, Roosevelt Island and Queens
unit: passenger places per service day per direction

capacity_assumption.basis: NYSDOT sample service guideline for a generic 40-foot low-floor bus, not verified Q102 fleet capacity.
capacity_assumption.full_bus_assumption: Each scheduled trip operates and carries 51 passengers across the bridge.

limitations: 51 is a user-approved assumption adapted from a sample planning guideline; it is not verified physical or operating capacity for Q102 buses.
Scheduled bus trips may not operate, and full-bus places are not ridership or guaranteed capacity available to board at an island stop.
Trips are assigned by GTFS service day, not the exact calendar day of their bridge crossing.
This counts Q102 trips only, not unscheduled, charter or other potential bridge-crossing bus services.
Island-only buses are excluded. The user specifies no direct Manhattan bus crossings in this inventory.
Bus and private-vehicle traffic share bridge road space; independent capacity figures cannot automatically be summed.
Combined directional places represent crossing opportunities, not unique travelers or round trips.
